title: Iran, US Trade Tanker Attacks, Strong US Payrolls Fuel Fed Hike Bets | The Asia Trade 9/7/2026
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Avril Hong and Paul Allen, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:02:03 - Fed rate path hangs on inflation after jobs print
00:07:31 - US military says it struck three Iranian crude tankers
00:11:50 -  ING's Deepali Bhargava on Asia's economic outlook
00:19:44 - Five dead after Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
00:28:06 - BOJ widely expected to hike in September
00:32:31 - OpenAI's Astra may revive its lagging AI trade
00:35:57 - Katayama to keep post in cabinet reshuffle: Reports
00:39:36 - EXCLUSIVE: Go President Hiroshi Nakajima on Japan's taxi market
00:47:09 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:51:05 - KCM Trade's Tim Waterer on market strategy
00:58:22 - OPEC+ sticks with plan to keep output quotas unchanged
01:01:54 - China injects billions of capital into mega banks, insurers
01:06:13 - EXCLUSIVE: Go President Hiroshi Nakajima on robotaxi opportunity in Japan
01:12:45 - Goldman Sachs' Daan Struyven on global commodities outlook
01:26:16 - Asia's biggest derivatives flows target China
01:31:10 - Chinese firms post strongest profit growth since 2021
